lifecycle: Move work items between lifecycle statuses.
lifecycle repair status: Force an item's status, with an audited reason.
lifecycle repair-status: Force an item's status, with an audited reason.
lifecycle skip record recoverable: Record a step skipped for a recoverable failure.
lifecycle skip record recoverable substr: Record a step skipped for a recoverable outage.
lifecycle skip record-recoverable-substr: Record a step skipped for a recoverable outage.
lifecycle transition: Move an item to another lifecycle status.
